images.subject: A high-tech nanite factory built around one colossal glass containment cylinder that rises almost to the top of the cliff. In the left half of the frame, on the open ground, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide low glass-roofed nanite processing hall glowing silver from inside.
images.detail: A swirling cloud of silver nanoparticles glows inside the cylinder.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.

images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering scorched dark basalt cliff with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks, with the ground all around made of baked deep muted oxblood-red earth, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.

images.subject: A high-tech nanite factory built around one colossal glass containment cylinder that rises almost to the top of the cliff. In the left half of the frame, on the open ground, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide low glass-roofed nanite processing hall glowing silver from inside. In the upper right of the frame, high up on the dark cliff face and well apart from the main cylinder, a third large and clearly separate block: a wide chamber cut into the rock behind a huge glass window glowing with a cloud of silver nanoparticles, reached by a long enclosed walkway.
